name: bridge
description: Root project for the BRIDGE Amplify Gen 2 backend (amplify/). The SPA is a self-contained npm project under web/.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,rt -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:runtime"
scripts.dev:api: npm run dev:venv && PYTHONPATH=runtime .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn api.local:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir api --reload-dir runtime/voice_kit
scripts.dev:runtime: npm run dev:venv && BRIDGE_LOCAL=1 PYTHONPATH=runtime .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn bridge.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --reload --reload-dir runtime --reload-dir resources --reload-include "*.txt" --reload-include "*.json"
scripts.dev:venv: [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo 'Missing .venv — run: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r api/requirements.txt -r runtime/requirements-voice.txt' >&2; exit 1; }
